newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe malaria kills over 2,000 people.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe malaria kills over 2,000 people.

text.p: Zimbabwe has recorded an unprecedented one million malaria cases and over 2,000 deaths from the disease this year, a health ministry official said on Monday.
Samuel Tsoka, the principal health education officer, told the local official news agency ZIANA, it was "the worst (national) epidemic of malaria in living memory".
He said 321 deaths were recorded last year from a couple of thousand cases, adding this year's record figures were a result of very wet weather immediately after a severe drought in 1995.
